title: Offer a copy button for code people run

do.text: Give commands and snippets meant to be pasted a copy button.

dont.text: Don't make people select code by hand on a phone: it is fiddly and error-prone.

do.text: Let long lines scroll sideways so the code keeps its shape; wrap prose-like lines only.

dont.text: Don't wrap code by default: indentation and alignment break across lines.
